instruction: Make me a Spotify playlist called "Most Listened Playlist Songs" containing only the most-played song from each of my playlists.

steps.code:
spotify_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "spotify")
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username="jepowell@gmail.com", password=spotify_password)
print(login_result)

access_token = login_result["access_token"]
playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(playlists))
print([(p["playlist_id"], p["title"], p["owner"]["email"], len(p.get("song_ids", []))) for p in playlists])

playlist_details = []
for p in playlists:
    detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p["playlist_id"], access_token=access_token)
    playlist_details.append(detail)

# For each playlist, collect song ids
for detail in playlist_details:
    print(detail["playlist_id"], detail["title"], [s["id"] for s in detail["songs"]])
